propositions: Two JSON-format derived files (index.json and criterion-pins.json) lack self-identifying markers because JSON has no comment syntax, causing developers to edit the generated artifact directly instead of the source, leading to multiple failed CI runs per story.

The index.json and criterion-pins.json files must gain top-level `_generated_by` string markers that are fixed points—the generators themselves emit them, so regeneration reproduces them byte-for-byte and drift gates remain green.

Existing tests comparing on-disk files to pure builder functions must be re-pointed at wrapper functions that include the markers (build_index_document() instead of build_prompt_index()), while the pure builders remain unchanged so their invariant tests pass untouched.

A comprehensive registry of all nine derived/parity-gated surfaces must be documented in docs/README.md with one table showing source, regenerate command, and enforcing CI gate, and a second table explicitly flagging three hand-authored-but-gated surfaces as NOT to be bannered.
load_catalog() must skip underscore-prefixed keys so the reserved `_generated_by` key in index.json never becomes a phantom reviewer.

A new test must parse the docs/README.md table and assert its row set exactly matches derived surfaces, failing if any derived file lacks its marker or if a known surface is missing from the registry.
